Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game! A low-scoring thriller! The World Cup keeps on giving surprises. On 28th October, Afghanistan will take on Ireland at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT) and later, England will face Australia at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). Do join us for the build up. Cheers!

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe says it is a special win. They worked hard to get in this round. Says they felt 20-25 runs short at the start but they bowled brilliantly and applauds the performance of Raza. Ends by appreciating the support they are getting.

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan says they should had definitely chased this down but are disappointed as they are not upto the mark with the bat. Adds he and Rizwan have responsibility but they got out. Reckons they need to use the new ball well. Shares that they are looking forward to the next match.

Sikandar Raza is the Player of the Match. He says he is lost for words and is proud of these players. Adds it is unbelievable but they kept believing until the end. Ends by saying that he recieved a clip of Ricky Ponting in the morning and that gave him extra motivation. He would like to thank Ricky Ponting for that.
...Presentation coming up...

Earlier in the day, after being asked to field, courtesy Wasim, Rauf and Shadab, Pakistan kept Zimbabwe to a very low score. However, what we thought was an under par score proved to be enough as Zimbabwe fought till the very last ball and won the game by the slightest of margins.

What can be said about Pakistan batting! When you have names like Babar, Rizwan and Masood you have to chase 131 down but yet again they just invited pressure on themselves. They took a cautious approach and went about things slowly. They lost wickets in the process and that always kept Zimbabwe in the hunt. Masood played brilliantly, he held one end up but he fell at the wrong time. Nawaz down the order played really well but when it mattered, he could not provide the goods. Twice in a row, he has turned as a villain. This is really heart breaking loss for them.

What a bowling effort this was from them. Right from the word go, their bowlers made it extremely tough for their batters. Evans, Blessing Muzarabani and Richard Ngarava were brilliant with the new ball. Raza was exceptional in the middle overs. Whenever, the game seemed to be slipping away, they managed to grab a wicket. Despite all of it, this was still Pakistan's game to win but it is Zimbabwe who kept their nerve and have emerged victorious.

3 in 3 is what they needed! Forget that, 131 is what they needed to chase and they have failed to do so. Zimbabwe are on cloud 9, they are elated. What a massive win this is, one that will go down jn history. Zimbabwe are celebrating it with the fans. Absolutely wonderful.

What a win! What a win this is! Pakistan, what have you done? Twice in a row, they have lost games they should have won and this loss may have just seen their chances of getting ahead into the tournament dented big time.

OUT! RUN OUT! ZIMBABWE HAVE DONE IT! What a cricket match we had! Absolute scenes at Perth! The Zimbabwe players are jumping on each other. Brad Evans cannot believe what just happened! What a match! Full and on middle, it is pushed to long on. Afridi runs hard but the throw is good enough to the keeper who clips the bails off. The keeper fumbles a bit but had enough time as he caught Shaheen Afridi well short of his crease. ZIMBABWE WIN BY 1 RUN. YES, 1 RUN.
Shaheen Afridi on the strike.

OUT! TAKEN! The game swings in Zimbabwe's favour now. Mohammad Nawaz sits with his head down. What a match this is turning out to be! Short ball, outside off. Nawaz tries to clear the mid off region but toe ends his shot and it goes straight in the hands of Craig Ervine. 3 runs needed in 1 ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Brad Evans

Commentary.Commentary: DOT BALL! Short in length and outside off. Nawaz tries to cut but gets cramped for room. 3 runs needed now in 2 balls.
Short in length and outside off. Wasim hammers it back to Evans. It burst through his hands and goes to mid off for a single. 3 runs needed in 3 balls.
FOUR! What a shot! Brad Evans tries the slower ball but bowls in the slot on middle. Wasim thumps it over the bowler's head for a boundary. 4 needed in 4.
Too full and outside off. Nawaz lofts it over covers. The fielder gives a chase, slides and does really well to save a single. The replay shows that is clean. THREE RUNS. 8 runs needed now.
Brad Evans to bowl the final over.
Very full and outside off. Wasim shuffles across to heave but misses. Pakistan need 11 runs in the last over. Mohammad Nawaz on the strike.
A low full toss on middle. Nawaz flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Nawaz keeps the hopes alive! A full toss on the pads. Nawaz whacks it over deep square leg, all the way for a biggie.

Full and on middle. Nawaz mistimes his loft to mid on, the falls in the vacant region. The fielder from long on runs in and throws to the bowler, Blessing Muzarabani who fumbles to whip the bails off. If that was taken cleanly, Wasim was clearly out.
Uses the pace of the wicket! Bangs a bouncer on middle, it shoots more. Nawaz looks to ramp it over but misses.
Fuller ball on middle Nawaz whips it to deep square leg for a couple of runs. Nawaz runs hard for the second.
On a length and around off. Wasim makes room as he looks to slash at it but misses. That was close to the off pole. Pakistan need 22 runs in 12 balls.
Fuller ball, outside off. Nawaz runs it to third man for one.
A slower bouncer on middle. Nawaz looks to play to third man but misses. Nawaz needs to play a key role from here.
On a length and on middle, slower ball. Wasim checks his shot and chips it in the air but falls in the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Short in length and on middle. Wasim pulls, gets a top edge and it flies behind the keeper for a boundary. Pakistan will take however it come.
On a length and on middle. Nawaz works it to third man for a single.
What an over from Ngarava! Zimbabwe have been just superb with the ball. Short ball, outside off. Wasim swings and misses. 29 runs needed in 18 balls.
Leg bye! Angling on the pads, Nawaz misses his flick and it goes off the pads to fine leg for one.
Length and on off. Wasim drops it to cover for a single.
Wide! Short in length and angling way outside off. Wasim flashes and misses.

An appeal for caught behind but the umpire doesn't move. Zimbabwe take the review. Short ball, around off. Wasim looks to pull but misses. Ultra Edge shows flat line. Not sure what the keeper heard there.
This is much closer to the off pole, on the shorter side. Wasim slashes and misses.
This one takes off! A bouncer, outside off. Wasim looks to push but misses.
Flatter and outside off. Nawaz punches it to point. Brilliant from Raza. 32 runs needed in 24 balls. Zimbabwe need 4 wickets.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! This is full and outside off. Nawaz leans to push but gets an outside edge to third man for a boundary.
A single as this is hit to cover.
On middle. Blocked out.

OUT! STUMPED! Masood is out. The set batter goes. Pakistan in all sort of trouble! Full, quicker and down the leg side. Masood misses his flick. The ball goes to Regis Chakabva. Shan Masood loses his balance and his back leg strides out of the crease. Regis Chakabva is quick to remove the bails and the umpire doesn't even have to take it upstairs as Masood is clearly out.
Commentary.Howout: st Regis Chakabva b Sikandar Raza

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and outside off, knocked to point.
On middle, Masood makes room and punches it to point. The man there misfields and allows a single. 38 runs needed in 30 balls.
On the pads, flicked behind square leg for a single.
Outside off, pushed through covers for one more.
Length and angling on middle. Nawaz tickles it to the right of the keeper who dives and gets his gloves on it but fails to catch it cleanly. The umpire gives a run, that will count as a drop.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.

On a length and on middle from around the wicket. Masood looks to work on the leg side but misses. An appeal for LBW and the finger stays down. Zimbabwe take the review. Brad Evans looks convinced but height might be the issue. No bat there. It is umpire's call on wickets hitting. NOT OUT!
That was close! Tossed up on middle. Nawaz defends it late and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Mohammad Nawaz comes out.

OUT! LBW! Two in two for Raza! A potential game changing over! Haider Ali's poor form continues. Raza tosses it up, full, quicker and on middle. Ali leans and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A huge appeal and up goes the finger. Haider Ali chats with Masood before taking it upstairs. This looks plumb. No bat and BALL TRACKING SHOWS THREE REDS. Sikandar Raza is pumped up. He is on a Hat-trick.

SIX AND OUT! Raza strikes and Zimbabwe have found the breakthrough! Tossed up again, around off. Khan this time tries to loft over long off but goes more off the outer half of the bat and Sean Williams at long off takes it. 43 runs needed in 38 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Sean Williams b Sikandar Raza

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! JUST OVER! Much needed! Tossed up on middle. Khan launches it over long on for a biggie. The stand moves above 50.
Wide! Down the leg side. Khan misses his flick. The keeper was interested for a while but no support from others.
A single as this is hit to long off.
Fuller ball, outside off. Masood looks to drive but gets an inside edge wide of off stump.
Two more! Good running by these two! On a length and on middle. Khan drills it to long on. Again hits it in the gap for two.
Two leg byes! Short and on the hips. Khan tucks it to square leg and calls for two. The second was risky but the batters make it.
A length ball, outside off. Masood slaps it through covers for a single.
Length and on middle. Khan is a bit late as he defends. It rolls on the leg side for a quick single.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Masood guides it to point for a single. Khan wanted another run but settles for one.
Masood calls for two and gets two! Length and outside off. Masood drives it to deep cover.
Tossed up on middle, Masood clips it to mid-wicket for one. 10 runs off the over. 60 runs needed in 48 balls.
Two more! Masood is hitting through the gaps! This is outside off, it's guided through point for two.
Flatter and outside off. Khan punches it to cover for a single.
Full and on middle. Masood flicks it to deep mid-wicket and settles with a single.
Wide! Way outside off. Masood leaves it alone.
On middle, this is hit to long on for one.
THREE RUNS! Pierces the gap! Short and outside off. Masood cuts it through bakward point and Blessing Muzarabani does well to save a single.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Touch short and on the pads. Khan sweeps it to square leg for one.
A single as this is hit to deep cover.
Outside off, flat. Masood slaps it to deep cover. A good throw was needed. The batters take two with ease.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket. Burl runs across and has a shy at his end but Khan was well in with a dive.
Flatter and outside off. Masood punches it to point for one.
Varies his pace nicely! Fires this into the pads. Khan works it to mid-wicket. A dot to end. Another tidy over.
Yet another one! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Shorter and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for another single.
On middle, this is worked throughg mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, Masood guides it towards point for a quick run.
A single to end a good over for Pakistan! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two is the call and two is what they get! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. Two is taken.
Nearly! Nearly chops it on! Shorter and just outside off, not enough room to cut, Masood goes for it but is beaten. Lucky he did not chop it on.
FOUR! That is a poor ball and it is put away! On the pads, fired on the pads, Masood just had to get bat on ball, he does and he beats short fine leg for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, Masood pushes it to covers.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

FOUR! Deft touch! Nicely played in the end! Length and around off, Masood waits and then guides it past the diving keeper and into the third man fence. A boundary to begin the over and one to end it. Still a wicket in it.
Angled into the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Iftikhar Ahmed is strangled down the leg side and Pakistan are in trouble here! He struggled for most parts of his innings and now walks back. This is on the pads, Iftikhar Ahmed looks to work it towards fine leg. This goes off the glove and it is taken nicely by the keeper. Game on, game well and truly on here. 95 needed in 74.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: A short ball on off, Masood is early in the pull, it goes off the toe-end towards mid off for one.
Good backing up! On off, this is pushed to cover. Iftikhar Ahmed takes off. He is sent back. The fielder has a shy to the bowler's end but misses. The fielder behind slides and backs up well.

FOUR! Innovation comes out and it brings about a much-needed boundary! Masood plays the paddle scoop, this is on a length and around middle, he looks to scoop it over short fine leg but drags it towards the third man fence. Good start to the over.

An appeal by the keeper but not sure why! On the pads, Iftikhar Ahmed looks to sweep, it goes off the top edge but lands short of the fielder at short fine leg. Another dot to end. Just the three from this over.
Another dot! Tossed up on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Angled into the pads, Masood works it through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle, a little bit of turn. It is played back to the bowler.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Tosses it up on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Iftikhar Ahmed misses out! A dot to end the 6th. A really good effort with the ball by Zimbabwe in the Powerplay! This is short and outside off, it is cut but to point.

FOUR! That was not good from Wesley Madhevere! He should have been a lot more aware there. Nevertheless, a welcome boundary for Pakistan. This is shorter and on middle, it is pulled past the mid on fielder. Luke Jongwe runs after it, dives and stops it. He pushes the rope behind. Wesley Madhevere picks the ball up but steps on where the ropes originally would have been. They go upstairs to check and it is a boundary. He could have avoided that but might have forgotten about it.
Length and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed pushes it towards mid on. Another dot.
That is well fielded! Length and around off, this one shapes away. Iftikhar Ahmed guides it to point.
On the pads, Masood looks to flick but misses. This hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
That is a top stop! Fuller and on middle, Masood strokes it to the right of the bowler who dives and stops it.
Length and on off. Defended out.
Outside off, Ahmed leaves it alone.

OUT! RIZWAN GOES! Zimbabwe have got two big wickets! Just what they wanted at an early stage! Blessing Muzarabani is pumped up! On a length and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan looks to dab it to third man but the ball is too close to play the shot. Rizwan couches a bit but ends up getting an inside edge and the ball hits the off stump.
On a length and on middle. Masood works it to cover for a single.
On a length and on the pads. Rizwan flicks it behind square leg for one.
Very full and outside off. Masood jams it out to third man for one.

SIX! GOES ALL THE WAY! This is full and on middle. Rizwan gets inside the line as he has a big swipe across but gets a top edge and the ball flies high behind the keeper and goes over the fence for a biggie.
On a length and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Very full and outside off. Shan Masood drives it to mid off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Brad Evans gets the big wicket! The captain was struggling and now he departs! On a length and around off, the ball sticks in the surface a bit and seams away as well. Babar Azam looks to work on the leg side but gets a leading edge and it flies to backward point where Ryan Burl holds onto it. A good start by Zimbabwe.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Burl b Brad Evans

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! This one is on the pads. Rizwan looks to heave but gets hit on the pads. It rolls to cover for a leg bye.
Very full and on off. Rizwan clips it straight to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Azam cuts it to the man at point. Milton Shumba leaps and saves a certain boundary. Eventful over! 9 runs from it.
FOUR! This will calm his nerves! Babar is off the mark! Short again, around off. Azam pulls it past mid on and mid-wicket for four runs.
QUICK SINGLE! A direct hit was needed! Length and on off. Rizwan drops it to mid off and takes a sharp single.
Length and outside off, cut to point.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! First off the chase. Short and outside off. Rizwan pulls it over mid-wicket for four.
Length and just outside off. Rizwan looks to push but it seams in and beats on the inside edge.
Full and on off, pushed to mid on.
Azam is yet to get off the mark! On a length and outside off. Azam looks to punch but misses.
Full again on middle. Rizwan sweeps across behind square leg for a single.
Right on the money from Blessing Muzarabani! Full and on off. Rizwan pushes it to mid off.
This is full and around off. Rizwan defends it to short cover.
On a length and on middle. Kept out.
On a length and outside off. Azam punches it straight to cover.
SWING AND A MISS! This is full and outside off. Azam looks to drive but misses.
Wide! This one swings down the leg side. Azam misses his flick. Good take by the keeper.
On a length and outside off. Azam flashes and misses.
On a length and outside off. Azam defends it out.
In the air but safe! Short ball on middle, Rizwan is hurried as he looks to pull. He is bit of cramped and the ball goes wide of square leg for a single.
Sharp start! Short in length on the hips, swinging in. Rizwan looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads.
